name: Portfolio Block – show off your work with stunning layouts
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Showcase your projects like a pro – build clean, modern, filterable portfolios right inside the WordPress block editor, no page builder required.

Portfolio Block | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo

Why Portfolio Block?

Portfolio Block makes it easy to create a clean, modern portfolio directly inside the WordPress block editor. It includes multiple layouts, category filters, responsive controls, and full design flexibility – ideal for freelancers, designers, photographers, agencies, or anyone who wants to showcase projects in a professional way.

Build a portfolio with the Gutenberg block, or generate a shortcode and display it anywhere on your site – pages, posts, widgets, footers, or page builders. Native Gutenberg, fast loading, lightweight, SEO friendly, and fully responsive, with unlimited projects and categories.

Free Features

  • Multiple Layouts: Grid, Masonry, and Card Hover layouts for flexible portfolio design.
  • Unlimited Categories: Organize projects with as many categories as you need and let visitors filter by category.
  • Portfolio Items: Add images, titles, descriptions, and external or internal links. Assign multiple categories per item.
  • Item Management: Duplicate, delete, or reorder items with simple controls.
  • Responsive Controls: Adjust columns, spacing, and layout settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Styling Options: Customize colors, borders, shadows, spacing, and overlay settings to match your theme.
  • View All Button: Add a customizable button linking to your full portfolio archive or a separate page.
  • Shortcode Support: Use your portfolio anywhere with the shortcode format [pfb id=”123″].

Pro Version – Unlock Advanced Features

Upgrade to Portfolio Block Pro for:

  • Advanced Layouts: Split Screen, Slider, Minimal List, and Stacked Cards for more dynamic presentation styles.
  • Typography Controls: Adjust fonts, sizes, colors, weight, and alignment for titles, categories, and descriptions.
  • Hover & Animation Effects: Premium hover transitions and animations for a more interactive experience.
  • Slider Options: Autoplay, loop, pause on hover, navigation controls, and speed settings for slider-based portfolios.
  • Advanced Styling: More control over buttons, badges, icons, overlays, and spacing.
  • Specialized Portfolio Blocks: Niche-specific, professionally designed blocks:
    • Developer Portfolio – showcase projects and technical work directly inside Gutenberg.
    • Fashion Portfolio – display fashion collections, lookbooks, and brand campaigns.
    • Marketing Portfolio – present case studies, campaign results, and marketing projects.
    • Photography Portfolio – highlight photography collections with visual-focused layouts.
    • Resume Builder – create a professional resume or CV portfolio page inside Gutenberg.
  • Priority Support: Faster support and ongoing updates with the Pro upgrade.

Common Use Cases

Portfolio Block can be used for many types of WordPress websites.

  • Personal Portfolio: Showcase your skills, experience, and creative work.
  • Freelancer Portfolio: Present client projects and attract new customers.
  • Developer Portfolio: Display websites, apps, plugins, and software projects.
  • Photography Portfolio: Create a visual photography gallery with lightbox support.
  • Agency Portfolio: Showcase services, client work, and successful projects.
  • Design Portfolio: Present graphic design, UI/UX, branding, and creative projects.
  • Marketing Portfolio: Display campaigns, case studies, and marketing projects.
  • Product Showcase: Present products, product designs, and featured work.
  • Creative Portfolio: Build a visually engaging portfolio for creative professionals.
  • Resume Portfolio: Combine professional experience, projects, and skills into a portfolio page.

Specialized Portfolio Blocks

Portfolio Block Pro includes professionally designed portfolio layouts for different professional needs.

Developer Portfolio
Showcase websites, applications, plugins, software projects, GitHub projects, and technical work.

Fashion Portfolio
Display fashion collections, campaigns, and creative fashion projects.

Marketing Portfolio
Present marketing campaigns, case studies, client results, and creative marketing work.

Photography Portfolio
Create an image-focused photography portfolio for photographers, studios, and creative professionals.

Resume Builder
Create a professional resume or CV portfolio page containing experience, projects, skills, and professional information.

Why Use Portfolio Block?

A good portfolio should make your work easy to discover, understand, and explore.

Portfolio Block gives you the tools to organize projects into professional portfolio layouts while keeping the editing experience inside WordPress Gutenberg.

You can:

  • Showcase projects in modern layouts.
  • Organize projects into unlimited categories.
  • Let visitors filter projects by category.
  • Display images, titles, descriptions, and links.
  • Create responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Open portfolio items in an image lightbox, gallery lightbox, or custom URL.
  • Reuse portfolios across your website.
  • Generate a shortcode when you need to display a portfolio outside the block editor.

How to Use – Quick Start

With the block editor:

  1. Install and activate Portfolio Block.
  2. Open the Block Editor and click the + icon.
  3. Search for Portfolio (by bPlugins) and insert the block.
  4. Add your portfolio items and customize your layout.
  5. Publish your page.

With the shortcode:

  1. Go to Portfolio Block → Add New Portfolio in the dashboard.
  2. Create your portfolio using the block editor and publish it.
  3. Copy the shortcode that appears after publishing.
  4. Paste it anywhere on your site where you want the portfolio to appear.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for “Portfolio Block” and find the plugin developed by bPlugins.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open a page in the Block Editor, insert the Portfolio (by bPlugins) block, and start adding your portfolio.

Upload via plugin installer:

  1. Download the portfolio-block.zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the portfolio-block.zip file and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file and extract it.
  2. Upload the extracted folder to /wp-content/plugins/ using FTP or File Manager.
  3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress dashboard, find Portfolio Block, and click Activate.
sections.faq:
Is Portfolio Block free?

Yes, the core plugin is free. A Pro version adds advanced layouts, typography controls, animations, and specialized portfolio blocks.

How do I get the shortcode?

After publishing a portfolio under Portfolio Block, you will see a Shortcode column in the portfolio list. Copy the shortcode ([pfb id=”123″]) and paste it anywhere on your site.

Can I use it with page builders?

Yes – it works with all page builders that support shortcodes.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, it is fully compatible with modern WordPress themes.

Can I customize layouts and styles?

Yes, all settings – layouts, colors, borders, shadows, spacing, and overlays – are editable in the block editor sidebar.

Can visitors filter projects by category?

Yes. You can organize projects into unlimited categories and let visitors filter the portfolio by category on the front end.

Can portfolio items open in a lightbox?

Yes. You can choose the click behavior for each portfolio: open a single-image lightbox, a gallery lightbox, or a custom URL.

Is the portfolio responsive on mobile?

Yes. You can adjust columns, spacing, and layout settings separately for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

Can I reuse the block?

Yes, you can use it as many times as you want, on as many pages as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Portfolio Block plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
